text: A shallow chip has appeared on the curb stone; vehicles move past normally.
Delivery vans keep swerving around broken asphalt at the depot entrance.
The bridge ramp has caved in and two riders are trapped beside the canal.
A small opening in the road has exposed sharp rebar where cyclists ride.
One streetlamp glows dimly but the lane remains well lit.
Every lamp on the pedestrian route to the bus stand has stopped working.
A live cable hangs from the lighting pole into a puddle near the market.
The timer on the school courtyard light stays on after sunrise.
Dry leaves cover part of a drain grate but rainwater still flows through.
Runoff has backed up from the roadside drain across several shop entrances.
An uncovered storm drain swallowed a pedestrian who needs rescue.
Raw sewage is rising through the drain into a crowded clinic walkway.
A public standpipe drips into a bucket once every few seconds.
A supply pipe under the sidewalk leaks steadily and nearby houses have weak pressure.
A water main burst next to an electrical cabinet and people feel shocks in the flood.
A small crack in a water pipe is spraying onto an exposed live wire.
A few food wrappers are beside the bin although the bin is mostly empty.
The collection truck missed two pickups and bags are piling up along the lane.
Used syringes and bloodied dressings were dumped where children play.
A little pile of rubbish is smouldering against a wooden stall with people inside.
A pack of stray dogs chased and bit a jogger outside the park.
The traffic signal at the crossing gives green to both directions at once.
The classroom ceiling fan makes a soft ticking noise but works normally.
Night construction noise keeps residents awake despite sound barriers.
There is a suspected gas leak from a restaurant kitchen cylinder.
